originality.rationale: The exact reduced-subtree and forest enumeration is explicitly credited to Pitman and Aldous–Pitman and not claimed new. The tested contribution is the conditional three-point geodesic survival matrix being a positive diagonal rescaling of the Pascal kernel, including all-minor strict support, and a strictly decreasing likelihood-ratio family for the pendant depth. Actual published-finding corpus semantic searches, prior research records claim scan, both accessible primary PDF mathematical sections, and the full closest published finding were compared; none stated these stronger inequalities. The broad marked-subtree formula implies the raw probabilities but does not itself give the all-order determinant and likelihood-ratio assertions. Historical implicit-priority risk is disclosed.

value.rationale: Three-point geodesic attachment depth is a natural local geometry statistic of a uniform tree, not a selected arbitrary numerical slice. The finite Pascal survival-kernel identity supplies every determinant-order inequality, its exact support and variation-diminishing interpretation, while the strict likelihood-ratio law controls all increasing risk functionals under increasing two-point separation. The result is an exact structural dependence classification, although the underlying enumerations are classical.
